title: 교실 한국어 읽기: 따라 하세요, 잘 들으세요
objective: Read 따라 하세요 and 잘 들으세요 aloud with the right sounds.
summary: Read common classroom instructions using the sound rules you have learned.

task.title: Read, choose, and write
task.line: Read each Korean part aloud first, then choose, fill in, or write the answer.

letters.as: The final consonant moves into the next silent ㅇ.
The final consonant and ㅎ join into a strong, breathy sound, like 'p' in 'pie'.

exercises: Choose the real sound, (a) or (b): ① 문을 닫으세요 — (a) [무늘 다드세요] (b) [문을 닫으세요] ② 앉으세요 — (a) [안즈세요] (b) [아느세요] ③ 축하해요 — (a) [축하해요] (b) [추카해요]
What does the teacher want you to do? Write read, write, listen, repeat, or answer: ① 공책에 단어를 쓰세요. ② 선생님 말을 따라 하세요. ③ 질문에 대답하세요.
Fill in the blank with 펴세요, 읽으세요, or 들으세요: ① 교과서를 ____. (open) ② 이 문장을 소리 내어 ____. (read) ③ 음악을 ____. (listen)
Put the words in order to make one instruction: ① 하세요 / 한 번 더 / 따라 ② 들으세요 / 대화를 / 잘
answers: ① write ② repeat ③ answer
① 펴세요 ② 읽으세요 ③ 들으세요
① 한 번 더 따라 하세요. ② 대화를 잘 들으세요.
